sink._doc: Per-wheel sinkage model. Bekker-style pressure-sinkage z = (p / k)^(1/n); k blends from compacted to loose sand by the loose mask. Dynamic digging from wheel slip. All ASSUMPTION-tuned (see DECISIONS W2.3).

deform._doc: CPU-authoritative deformation height grid, toroidal window following the vehicle, uploaded as an RG16F texture (R = height delta m, G = disturbed 0..1).

particles._doc: Instanced GPU sand spray, analytic ballistic motion with drag. Budget per quality preset (quality.json particles).
